name: codex-model-benchmarks
description: Reproducible Codex model TTFT, delivered TPS, and completion-time measurements.

scripts.chart:png: npm run chart && rsvg-convert -w 1600 -h 900 assets/codex-model-latency.svg -o assets/codex-model-latency.png
scripts.cards:png: npm run cards && rsvg-convert -w 1600 -h 900 assets/total-time.svg -o assets/total-time.png && rsvg-convert -w 1600 -h 900 assets/ttft.svg -o assets/ttft.png && rsvg-convert -w 1600 -h 900 assets/delivered-tps.svg -o assets/delivered-tps.png
